note: Saved findings of one tool name (openqodex-library-r1) on two Martian-shaped cases, in report.json's finding shape. evaluation.json beside this file names them by findingId.

findings.title: Cache read races with the writer
findings.problem: The entry is read after the lock is released.
findings.consequence: Two writers can both miss and both insert, so one write is lost.
findings.fix: Read and insert under the same lock.

findings.title: Widget id reaches the SQL string
findings.problem: The id from the request is joined into the query text.
findings.consequence: A crafted id runs any SQL the attacker writes.
findings.fix: Pass the id as a bound parameter.

findings.title: Eviction skips the newest entry
findings.problem: The loop stops one entry early.
findings.consequence: The newest entry is never evicted.
findings.fix: Loop to the last index inclusive.

findings.title: Constant name is vague
findings.consequence: A reader cannot tell what it holds.

findings.title: Retry counter shared without a lock, and the endpoint answers 200
findings.problem: Workers increment one counter with no lock, and the handler returns 200 with an empty body for a missing delivery.
findings.consequence: Retries are counted wrong, and clients that wait for 404 never stop polling.
findings.fix: Guard the counter with the worker mutex and answer 404 for a missing delivery.

findings.title: Counter lock is missing
findings.fix: Take the worker mutex around the increment.
